The placement agents will receive a fee of 1.00% per Note, but will forgo fees for sales to fiduciary accounts.

If the Final Value of the S&P 500® Index (the “Reference Asset”) is equal to or greater than 85.00% of the Initial Value (the “Buffer Value”), the Notes offer the opportunity to earn a fixed return equal to 7.62% of the Principal Amount (the “Digital Return”).
